content.text: ⚠️ ChatGPT Web Luna cannot access the local Codex computer in this turn. The accumulated context does not contain local tool results yet: it will see instructions and attachments, but not workspace contents. ChatGPT-native capabilities such as web search remain available when the product provides them. This installation is in Browser-only mode. Open MCP in the launcher and connect the Full harness to give Instant through Extra High access to local tools.

json:chatgpt-review

{

  "verdict": "CONDITIONAL\_APPROVAL",

  "score": 8,

  "layer\_assessment": {

    "layer\_1\_correctness": "PASS\_WITH\_LIMITATIONS",

    "layer\_2\_security": "REQUIRES\_VERIFICATION",

    "layer\_3\_architecture": "PASS\_WITH\_LIMITATIONS",

    "layer\_4\_ux": "PASS",

    "layer\_5\_zero\_regression": "PASS\_WITH\_LIMITATIONS"

  },

  "blockers": \[\],

  "major\_issues": \[

    "The supplied evidence is an implementation summary rather than the actual source diff, so security-sensitive claims such as RLS/student isolation, webhook authentication, authorization of bank-info writes, and exact reconciliation behavior cannot be independently verified.",

    "A UNIQUE constraint on transaction\_id provides database-level idempotency only if the webhook handler handles duplicate-key races safely and does not perform non-atomic reconciliation before the insert. The exact transaction ordering must be verified.",

    "External payment webhook authenticity is not established by the summary. If the endpoint is internet-facing, accepting unauthenticated webhook payloads is a production security risk even when transaction\_id is unique."

  \],

  "minor\_improvements": \[

    "Add webhook HMAC/signature verification and timestamp/replay protection when supported by the payment provider.",

    "Verify RLS policies explicitly cover columns.is\_shared\_with\_parents, profiles.bank\_info, payment\_transactions, and column\_records, including cross-student and cross-class access.",

    "Prefer an atomic database-side reconciliation transaction or RPC so payment audit insertion and column-record mutation cannot diverge.",

    "Add tests for duplicate concurrent webhooks, malformed orderInfo, unknown COLID, wrong class/student code, amount mismatch, and already-paid records.",

    "Document the precedence and lifecycle rules when both school-level and teacher personal bank accounts exist.",

    "Confirm QR generation rejects invalid account numbers and unsupported bank identifiers rather than producing a misleading payment QR."

  \],

  "summary": "The reported 22/22 zero-mock tests and successful 34/34-route production build are strong evidence for functional and regression quality, and the feature decomposition is architecturally sensible. However, a senior security audit cannot honestly issue a full APPROVED/10 verdict from the implementation summary alone. The highest-risk areas are webhook authenticity/replay protection, RLS/data isolation, authorization of bank-account settings, and atomic idempotent reconciliation. Subject to direct source-level verification of those controls, the implementation appears release-ready."

}

The key distinction is that **the reported tests/build justify confidence in the implementation, but they do not by themselves prove the security boundary**. I would not mark Layer 2 as an unconditional PASS without inspecting the actual RLS policies and webhook route.
